messages:
erin_ap: Invoice INV-5590 arrived referencing PO 5590 but AP matched it to a different vendor/account. System flagged vendor mismatch and put invoice on hold. Need quick confirm from procurement.
jas_procure: Pulling PO record... PO 5590 exists twice: PO-5590-NA (Acct 00412) and PO-5590-EMEA (Acct 00988). Legacy numbering collision.
luke_sales: We asked the vendor to bill to EMEA account; they probably omitted suffix. I'll ping them.
vendor-bot: BeaconWorks (billing@beaconworks.co) uploaded INV-5590 (PDF)  shows "PO: 5590" and "Project: EMEA Launch". Attachment: https://files.example.com/beaconworks/INV-5590.pdf
omer_fin: Also invoice currency EUR; AP converted with rate 1.087 but treasury prefers 1.092 for invoice date. Need treasury confirmation before payment.
jas_procure: Vendor replied: "Confirm PO 5590 corresponds to EMEA Launch and should map to PO-5590-EMEA (Acct 00988). No reissue required."
finance-bot: Automation created task T-22110: add PO alias 5590->PO-5590-EMEA and rematch.
erin_ap: Applied alias match, re-run. Match succeeded. Coding to GL 5301 (marketing).
payments_lead: Treasury confirms use of invoice date FX 2025-10-03 rate 1.092. Converted USD total 23,184. Payment hold removed and scheduled for next EMEA run.
jas_procure: I'll file change request to prevent PO number collisions (lock entity suffix on creation).
omer_fin: Great. Closing thread: invoice matched to PO-5590-EMEA, vendor confirmed, FX updated, scheduled for payment. :white_check_mark:
